description:
if you approached every girl you found attractive for the next year

you would no longer need to look at dating content

so why don’t you do that?

its because your biggest block isn’t the action itself…

its your MIND

you’ve built up this identity as a guy who struggles with women and is TRYING to figure it out

and because of that a simple solution CANNOT be acted on

it would interfere with who you think you are.

thats the cause of most of your anxiety when approaching

its not so much “what if it goes bad”

you almost expect it to

the real fear is “what if it goes well”

you’d have to shed this whole identity you’ve been building up for YEARS

this is why self understanding is NECESSARY for change

if you can TRULY change your thoughts and feelings around a topic…

the actions become EFFORTLESS

do you understand?
transcript: If you just decided, I'm going to approach every beautiful girl that I see, I'm going to go say hi, I'm going to give her a nice little compliment on something, maybe you like her jacket, and then you're going to get her Instagram and you're going to take her on a date. And whether she says yes or no, it doesn't matter. That's just what you're going to do. Eventually, it could be a year, it could be a month, it could be two days, you're going to get a girlfriend and your issue will be solved. But the main reason that you're not doing that, because you've heard that advice before, the main reason that you're not going about doing that is because you've identified as the kind of guy that can't get girls. I'm just not good like that. I'm just going to be alone for the rest of my life, but I'm trying to solve it, right? You've identified with this lacking identity. And because of that, there's a huge energetic barrier to any solution because that would mean you'd have to dissolve that identity. This is key. It's not the action itself that's difficult. It's the identity that you've attached yourself to. And once you can dissolve that, once you stop identifying with this lacking, like, I just can't get it right sort of identity, you'll just automatically go do the thing because it's that simple. So it's never been the action that's difficult. It's your state of mind. Look within. Why are you identifying with limiting beliefs? Why aren't you confident in yourself? Why don't you feel good about your life and everything that you're doing? Those are the things that you need to resolve because when you have no more internal blocks, life becomes easy. Everything becomes better.
